steps.content: [Big CG: Final Battle Long Shot]

Before Jichuan, Ji Guining's body convulses and contorts beyond control. Her spine bulges grotesquely, limbs stretching outward like withered branches. Within moments, the Princess, who once sat dignified in her wheelchair, has transformed completely into a hideous, crouching monster.

Jichuan does not retreat. Plum branch in hand, she taps it gently against the ground as she walks step by step toward the massive, grotesque creature. Her eyes reveal no fear; instead, they shine with compassion and quiet acceptance.

In her days traveling Northwild as Shuang'er, she has seen countless snow-covered vistas, yet none compare to the beauty before her now... Such a pity that this crimson and white splendor will be witnessed by her alone.
[Flashback: Shuang'er asking Xiaofeng to help the Chief before her identity is exposed]

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I never imagined... that you would be the one to find me first.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So you're sending them off yourself, I take it. Got any last words you want me to pass along to that silly boy?
steps.female_content: So you're sending them off yourself, I take it. Got any last words you want me to pass along to that silly girl?

steps.content: Jichuan peered into the storm beyond the dark chamber, her gaze distant. It was as if she were looking past the cold front—the herald of the final slaughter—and through layers of memory to scenes buried deep in the past.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: He... was never part of my design.
steps.female_content: She... was never part of my design.

steps.content: She paused, suppressing again and again the chaotic force that coursed through her.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: A stranger arrived at Northwild, no background, no known martial arts, no clear purpose. An uncontrollable element, walking uninvited into a scheme I spent years weaving...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: When I first approached him as Shuang'er, it was to watch him, to understand what he was. To use his presence as a veil, to observe the others from within the crowd.
steps.female_content: When I first approached her as Shuang'er, it was to watch her, to understand what she was. To use her presence as a veil, to observe the others from within the crowd.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I've encountered far too many people from the martial world. The arrogant ones, who look upon common folk as less than dust. The scheming ones, who measure all things by gain and loss. The righteous ones, whose tongues drip with virtue while their hands reach for the blade behind your back... I assumed he would be no different.
steps.female_content: I've encountered far too many people from the martial world. The arrogant ones, who look upon common folk as less than dust. The scheming ones, who measure all things by gain and loss. The righteous ones, whose tongues drip with virtue while their hands reach for the blade behind your back... I assumed she would be no different.

steps.content: Another surge of darkened blood interrupted her. Wiping the fresh crimson from the corner of her mouth with the back of her hand, she continued to regulate her breathing.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: But he told me... that the martial world he believed in wasn't about whose skill was greater. It was a place that could hold sincerity, that could bear ideals worth bleeding for. That even a futile pursuit, fought to the last breath, still had meaning.
steps.female_content: But she told me... that the martial world she believed in wasn't about whose skill was greater. It was a place that could hold sincerity, that could bear ideals worth bleeding for. That even a futile pursuit, fought to the last breath, still had meaning.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: He said stories may be illusions, but the impulse behind them is real. Traveling a thousand miles for a single promise. Drawing your blade at the sight of injustice. Loyalty, courage, faith kept at any cost... those things must have lived, somewhere in this vast land.
steps.female_content: She said stories may be illusions, but the impulse behind them is real. Traveling a thousand miles for a single promise. Drawing your blade at the sight of injustice. Loyalty, courage, faith kept at any cost... those things must have lived, somewhere in this vast land.

steps.content: Once more, her gaze sharpened with resolve, fixed on the valley below and the unknown future that lay ahead.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: The manor is sealed. No ordinary person can make it down the mountain alive, but you are no ordinary person. Do this for me, Xiaofeng. Wait for him at the bottom. I'll carve him a path. He doesn't need to be part of this slaughter. He only needs to live.
steps.female_content: The manor is sealed. No ordinary person can make it down the mountain alive, but you are no ordinary person. Do this for me, Xiaofeng. Wait for her at the bottom. I'll carve her a path. She doesn't need to be part of this slaughter. She only needs to live.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Let him see for me. Let him speak for me. Let him tell those beyond these peaks how greed devoured itself, how a corrupt legacy burned to ash in a single night.
steps.female_content: Let her see for me. Let her speak for me. Let her tell those beyond these peaks how greed devoured itself, how a corrupt legacy burned to ash in a single night.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: The manor will fall. My enemies will fall. And I... will fall. But someone must remain to tell them after... that someone once tried to tear open this iron curtain of wind and snow. And nearly succeeded.
Having said all this, she appeared to have exhausted the last shred of her strength.
Maintaining Shuang'er's innocent and lively facade had drained so much of her, yet now that she was finally on the verge of dropping the act, she found herself reluctant to let it go.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Tell him... to live, and then... don't forget.
steps.female_content: Tell her... to live, and then... don't forget.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Don't forget what?
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Don't forget that it was he who showed Shuang'er that there's still warmth left in this world.
steps.female_content: Don't forget that it was she who showed Shuang'er that there's still warmth left in this world.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: If one day the stories of heroes and this martial world fade, let it be because peace has come at last. Because no one needs heroes anymore to break the iron rules and right the wrongs.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: We have generations ahead. Time enough. And if I cannot live to see that golden peace, then let this flawed, fleeting life of mine be the key that opens the door.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: As for the stories after... let him tell them in my place.
steps.female_content: As for the stories after... let her tell them in my place.

steps.content: Her words fade, and Jichuan's eyes grow sharp, freezing the falling snow in mid-air. With the slightest raise of her plum branch, the snow within a hundred feet erupts, a white dragon soaring skyward with a thunderous roar. Beneath this same sky, a newcomer drifts into the town's familiar corner, learning to unfold a new martial world as Shuang'er once did.

steps.speaker: Mountainfoot Storyteller
steps.content: Esteemed audience, lend me your ears! Upon Mount Fuyun, nestled in Northsnow Manor, there dwells a young lady, frail as a willow frond, yet fierce as a winter gale. Her body, delicate enough to be snapped by a sigh, houses a heart blazing with heroic fire. The fragile plum hides a blade, and winter branches dream of spring thunder.
The wind rises. Snow spirals into waves, drawing the scattered plum blossoms into a roaring vortex atop the mountain peak. Jichuan stands at the eye of the storm, her robes billowing wildly.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Point to whole, sever the core!

The monster swings its massive branches down at her, but Jichuan neither dodges nor retreats. Instead, she guides her weapon upward; a snow dragon splits from the vortex and crashes thunderously into the attacking limb. Snow explodes outward as the colossal beast is driven back three feet.

steps.speaker: Mountainfoot Storyteller
steps.content: She poured her soul into the pursuit of heroism, only to find the Northwild martial world—for all their boasts of righteous men and noble deeds—teeming with vipers in heroes' clothing. The so-called "martial world"? A den of deceivers. "Honor"? A silk veil draped over greed. "Justice"? A cudgel to beat the innocent.

The monster flies into a rage and launches Jichuan high into the air with a single blow. Blood mist sprays from her lips, yet she doesn't hesitate for an instant. Spinning her plum branch once more, she peels more snow streams from the vortex. These streams transform into several snow serpents, as thick as pillars, that coil tightly around the monster's limbs and torso.

steps.speaker: Mountainfoot Storyteller
steps.content: Did she flinch? Did she fold? No, the master of Northsnow Manor refused to retreat a single step! If the world is thick with hollow champions, she thought, then let them be unmasked. If corruption has become the custom, then let it be purged. And so she proclaimed a grand feast for all.

The monster shrieks in agony, its cry shaking the snow around them. Jichuan is slammed hard toward the ground, but in the last instant before impact, she twists, plants her plum branch, and springs back to her feet. The blow, however, has been too fierce. The branch cracks in her hand, and her palm becomes a mangled mess of blood and flesh.

steps.speaker: Mountainfoot Storyteller
steps.content: No invitations were sent, yet the rumor spread like wildfire. Those hungry for glory caught the scent and swarmed the mountain paths. Those drunk on silver crawled through snow and sleet to reach her gate. Are there no true heroes left in this world? Then lift your eyes and see: Fists like thunder shake the plum blossoms; staffs like rivers sweep the snow. False idols fall, true hearts rise, and the battle is far from over!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Spirit and will as one, now!

The blizzard vortex collapses inward. Plum blossoms and shards of ice frantically converge on the point where her branch aims. The wind shrieks with a piercing howl, and the falling snow thickens, taking on an eerie blue hue.

Jichuan's face is nearly translucent, blood seeping from the corners of her mouth, each droplet freezing into a crimson pearl against the snow. But her eyes blaze with an unyielding intensity, and her weapon remains a monolith in her steady grasp.

The sounds of the festival below and the warmth of human life have faded from her senses. Yet, in the heart of the storm, it feels as though a thousand untold stories and all forms of warmth merge into a single current, flowing into her wrist.
In this moment, the very wind and snow hold their breath.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Ji Guining...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Your vaunted phoenix bloodline, your dreams of imperial heritage... in the end, nothing but an empty shell hollowed out by greed.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: You are no different from the others who came to this manor. In your eyes... there is only taking, never bearing. Only possessing, never responsibility.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Fate has called in its debt. Let me be the one to end your tragedy.
The plum branch thrusts forward! A blade of pure white light carves a straight line through the frozen world, cutting through the swirling wind and snow to spear directly toward the monster's heart.

Then, in an instant, the blizzard converges. It funnels through the wound, a raging flood that scours the monster's flesh from the inside out. Ice crystals burst from its core, and with them, a hail of wood chips and black blood explodes into the air.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: This battle of ours will become a legend of Northwild. That pinnacle of the martial world you so desperately sought... your name is finally carved upon it.
The howling wind slowly unravels her hair bun. Through the strands of black silk, her gaze holds a sorrowful compassion as she regards the fallen "hero" before her.

The monster writhes in its death throes, and a thick branch suddenly coils around her waist. Jichuan does not dodge or retreat; instead, she drives her plum branch deeper still. The weapon's broken forks hook into the monster's flesh like barbs, binding her and the massive creature together in an inescapable embrace.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Mudling... did you see? I have become quite the accomplished manor master.
She lifts her head toward the last small patch of clear sky at the storm's eye. With a smile, she closes her eyes and exhales her final breath.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Plum blossoms... on the other shore.
